Title: Public Preview: Azure SQL updates for late-February 2024

Body.Content:
In late-February 2024, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL: 

  • You can now enable zone redundancy for Azure SQL Database Hyperscale elastic pools for increased resiliency and higher availability.
Body.Markdown:
In late-February 2024, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL:
